findings: Completed source reading of significant-bit scaling, palette expansion, unpacking, IHDR/PLTE/sBIT/chromaticity/physical/time/EXIF/keyword validation and non-IDAT metadata parser.
Read undo/cache bookkeeping for text/suggested palettes/unknown chunks, optional malformed ancillary discard, initial row decode/conversion and Adam7 scatter, plus beginning of decode_image.
Critical versus ancillary policy matters: selected metadata validation errors are discarded when non-strict and ancillary; these errors do not automatically prove public decode failure.
RGBA8 output from 16-bit input takes high byte in source; RGBA16 conversion/scale order and native endian need continued end-to-end qualification. Current wrapper chooses G8 or RGB8 only.
Existing own PNG alpha regression covers explicit GA/RGBA only, not tRNS/palette transparency, sBIT, ICC, gamma or Adam7. These remain distinct coverage requirements.
No new runtime test, production code adoption or speed claim in this increment. Previously confirmed filter controls do not qualify metadata/parser behavior.
